response.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, AVG(1.0 * Bytes / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track WHERE Bytes > 10323804;

assumptions.assumption: A large track has more than 10323804 bytes; a track exactly at the cutoff is excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is inclusive, so tracks with exactly 10323804 bytes are large.
